ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Unmovable.cs:16-19) == cost 2 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars (the power amount is the literal 1). It does NOT override GainsBlock -- the Block hover tip (Unmovable.cs:14) is explanatory, UnmovablePower doubles OTHER cards' block -- and the sim leaves `gains_block` False.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<UnmovablePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Unmovable.cs:25) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, UnmovablePower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: NPowerUpVfx (23) and TriggerAnim (24). UnmovablePower is one of the eight C# `ModifyBlockMultiplicative` implementers the creature_card_cmds seam pins for gap G1 (x2) and one of its five ported counterparts; the power's own behaviour is the power stream's, but note that the seam's G1 dormancy/liveness argument depends on its factor being binary-exact, which x2 is.
